standard.summary: 将 Q、K、V 三个线性投影合并为一个融合矩阵乘法操作，减少 CUDA kernel launch 次数，提升注意力计算效率。
standard.effect: 开启后 QKV 投影通过一次矩阵乘法完成（而非三次），减少 kernel launch 开销约 30%，提升总体训练速度约 2~5%。
standard.whenToUse: 默认应尝试开启（若模型支持），对 Anima 架构的 native forward 有优化效果。
standard.avoidWhen: 模型的 QKV 权重未融合时（需要 weight merging 操作），或 LoRA 注入方式与 fused QKV 不兼容时会自动 fallback。

standard_en.summary: Merges the Q, K and V linear projections into one fused matmul, cutting the number of CUDA kernel launches and making attention more efficient.
standard_en.effect: Once on, the QKV projection is done in a single matmul instead of three, cutting launch overhead by roughly 30% and total training time by roughly 2% to 5%.
standard_en.whenToUse: Worth having on by default where the model supports it; it optimises the native forward of the Anima architecture.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It falls back automatically when the model's QKV weights are not fused (a weight merge would be needed) or when the LoRA injection style is incompatible with fused QKV.

advanced.principle: Fused QKV 将 W_Q, W_K, W_V 沿 head 维度拼接为一个 W_QKV，单次矩阵乘法 xW_QKV 得到 QKV 拼接结果，再 chunk 分割。减少内存读写次数（W_Q/K/V 分别读取 → 一次读取 W_QKV）。
advanced.tradeoffs: LoRA 注入 fused QKV 时需要特殊处理（拼接 LoRA 权重对应维度），部分 LoRA 实现可能与之不兼容，遇到问题时关闭。

advanced_en.principle: Fused QKV concatenates W_Q, W_K, W_V along the head dimension into one W_QKV; a single matmul xW_QKV yields the concatenated QKV, then chunk splits it. Fewer memory reads/writes (three separate W_Q/K/V reads → one W_QKV read).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: LoRA injection into fused QKV needs special handling (concatenating LoRA weights along the matching dims); some LoRA implementations may be incompatible — turn it off if problems arise.
